description:
One sunny day day, a portal burst open in the garden, and Kwon Jae-Jin got caught up in the chaos. His limbs were torn off, and he died...

…Or so he thought. 

When he wakes up, he finds himself back on the first day of his captivity—with Seo Wui-Wu between his legs, tugging at his pants. Jae-Jin stares down at the familiar face, one he had come to resent over the four agonizing years of his previous life. Back then, he had believed he was merely a victim, dragged into an unfamiliar place and forced into submission. But this time is different. Now, Jae-Jin knows exactly how Seo Wui-Wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-Wu will be his to manipulate. As Seo Wui-Wu’s breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement. Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?

(Source: Lezhin US)
